coverage_gaps.detail: Task asked 13 families per player. Logs show collapsed OR. Players with family hits: 走力+パワプロ 100, 走力+プロスピ 100, 走力+査定 100, 俊足 48, 鈍足 46, 高すぎ 9, 低すぎ 10, おかしい 9, 上げろ 1, 下げろ 1, 走力A/B/C 4, 足速 0, 足遅 0. Family-count histogram: 45 players have only 3/13 families.

These 9 appear in web_search and/or surname-batch queries, but not in a dedicated x_keyword_search with the full name. Builder also force-marks all 100 searched if agent C/D files exist, so published 100/100 is partly circular.

verdict: FAIL_CLOSED_PARTIAL. current_100 is no longer null-hardcoded and all 100 names were queried at least once. A usable minority rating-lane exists (カリステ A-too-high, 野間 still-A, 安田 E46 stale, 森下 too-low, 山川 G-joke). Do not treat 188 accepted rows as 188 independent speed-rating origins. Do not close SP-035 as DONE_VALIDATED or DONE_NEGATIVE_FINDING.
recommended_status_reason: Search happened on the real 100 list and found current-100 rating claims, so the old 0-criticism-because-null-hardcode result is obsolete. Remaining holes are material: collapsed query family (足速/足遅 never run; 高すぎ family not per-player), 9 names without full-name x_keyword, official reply paging NOT_COLLECTED, empty official texts, independence_group collapse broken (143 accepted in x:undefined), multi-agent same-post double counts (31 posts), WEB/YouTube leaked into the X lane, and at least two identity errors (山本大斗→山本祐大, 筒香 comparison→subject). Yield is not zero, so not a negative finding. Quality is not good enough for DONE_VALIDATED.
do_not: Do not change SP-033/034 or YouTube artifacts.
Do not use n_rating in player_summary as independent origin counts.
Do not treat WEB_RATING_SNAPSHOT as X community evidence.
